annotations.title: Verify every checkable claim in a text (bulk)

description: Bulk verifier: paste text, get per-claim statuses. ASSERTIONS ONLY: a QUESTION ('is it $9.4M?') binds nothing and returns total 0; single-value questions are not claims and are not checked here. Deterministic grammar, four families: loan fields, pool fields, servicer identity, loan-status counts. Unparsed text is listed in unchecked_spans, never dropped. EXACT deal references (id, alias, CIK) work best; matching is never fuzzy. Statuses (verified / contradicted / insufficient_evidence / out_of_scope) are answers, not errors. Each claim has a claim_id, citations and a confidence.

deal_hint.description: Fallback deal context when a sentence names no deal (exact resolution only).

period_hint.description: YYYY-MM annotation only — latest-only server; a mismatch is noted and drops confidence one tier.

risk_tolerance.description: Default normal = max(ledger tolerance, stated precision); strict = ledger only; lenient = 2x stated precision. Counts and names are always exact.

text.description: The paragraph / memo excerpt to check.

name: verify_claims

claims.description: Per claim: normalized_claim, citations, notes, recommended_language.

summary.description: Counts: total, verified, contradicted, insufficient_evidence, out_of_scope.

unchecked_spans.description: Text no grammar rule could check, with reason and hint.
